svg.title: TrueNorth Home Practice furniture assembly portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional handyman services portfolio concept for TrueNorth Home Practice, showing a neatly assembled console and mounted framed print. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
